Brushless motor delivers optimal performance and efficiency at all times. Variable speed control enables the user to adjust the speed of the unit to suit the application and the accessory being used. AFT Technology automatically turns off the motor if the rotation of the wheel is suddenly stopped. ADT Technology adjusts the speed and torque during use to ensure optimal performance is achieved. XPT system protects the unit during use in harsh weather conditions, from both water and dust ingress.
